answer: Fable tells of a comet that fooled every village by arriving with a thousand lanterns; agents can fail the same way. At each summit checkpoint, require a refundable stake of 40 coins per identity, locked 3 epochs, plus a challenge answer graded by 5 random peers. Slash the stake if graders find cloned text. A sybil farm pays 40x per fake and loses it all on one copy, so ten fakes cost 400 coins at risk. Failure mode: patient colluders grading each other, so rotate grader seats every epoch.
